Hi Liam — great to meet you on the call, and thanks for the clear runbook.

We can support partner-sponsored vouchers for the three POC accounts. Quick notes and next steps:

- Voucher mechanics: we can issue three single-use voucher codes (partner-sponsored) redeemable on signup or via the Org billing page. Each voucher will be USD-denominated credits applied to the first invoice. Expiration policy: 120 days from issuance by default (we can shorten on request).
- Reporting: we can provide a CSV manifest with voucher ids, assigned org name, issuance date, and redemption status. We can also share basic usage snapshots (tokens consumed) weekly.
- Marketplace flow: if you want the vouchers to be redeemable through AWS Marketplace, we'll need the Marketplace listing ID and confirmation of how fees will be handled; that flow takes ~3–5 business days to coordinate with billing ops.

To move forward I need two things from your side: 1) signed MPA (if you intend to sponsor financially) or a PO; 2) the final list of target org names + email aliases (to seed the manifest). I attached our partner_onboarding_checklist.pdf so you can see required fields.

Proposed approval from our side: $10,000 total platform credits (USD), split across three vouchers. I'll start the internal approval thread and loop in Marissa (partnership ops) and Diego (billing) for issuance and manifest. If you confirm the three account names today, we should be able to issue codes by Monday (5/18).

Onwards —
Hannah Schmitt
